title: AstroRegolithSidecarMetadata
description: Sidecar metadata schema for regolith plant-growth images (CSV row mapping or JSON list). Extends the AstroBotany calibration-image schema with the substrate fields a regolith study turns on, and with days_after_sowing / n_leaves, which are named to match the NASA OSD-476 deposit so a contributed series can be plotted on the same axes as the Apollo plants.

filename.description: The exact name of the image file, including extension (e.g. IMG_1212_cropped.jpg). Used as a primary key to match with physical image files.

species.description: Standard scientific or common name of the organism (e.g. Landoltia punctata, Arabidopsis thaliana).

genotype.description: Plant mutant line, ecotype, genotype, or accession number (e.g. Col-0, pgm1-1).

treatment.description: The experimental treatment, growth condition, or dosage applied (e.g. Gibberellic Acid, Control, Clinostat, 1g).

environment.description: Gravity or flight context, e.g. Ground control (1g), Clinostat, ISS.

substrate_class.description: What the plant was rooted in. Blends use 'blend' and give substrate_blend_pct.

substrate_name.description: Substrate name or source, e.g. Apollo 11, JSC-1A, LHS-1, LMS-1, MGS-1, MMS-2, Exolith CI.

substrate_batch.description: Supplier lot or batch. Simulant composition varies between production runs, so two datasets naming the same simulant are not necessarily comparable without this.

substrate_blend_pct.description: Percent regolith or simulant by volume: 100 for neat, 0 for the control. Places the entry on a dose-response axis.

substrate_particle_size_um.description: Mean particle size or range in micrometres. Drives water retention and root penetration resistance more than bulk chemistry does.

substrate_pretreatment.description: Pre-treatment applied. Leaching in particular changes the ionic stress the root sees.

amendment.description: Anything mixed in or applied beyond water (perlite, peat, nutrient solution, biochar, inoculant, chelator), with rates.

sowing_date.description: ISO 8601 sowing date. OSD-476 omitted this, and its growth curves cannot be placed on an absolute age axis as a result.

days_after_sowing.description: Days from sowing to this image. The shared time axis; matches OSD-476's 'age at sample harvest'.

n_leaves.description: Visible true leaves. Matches OSD-476's 'Number of Leaves' so contributed series are directly comparable.

germinated.description: Germination outcome. Record the failures: zeroes are results.

stress_symptoms.description: Observed symptoms, e.g. anthocyanin/reddening, chlorosis, stunting, leaf distortion, necrosis — the morphologies Apollo-grown plants showed.

glds_accession.description: The NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) / GeneLab dataset accession ID (e.g. OSD-670).

experiment.description: Name or unique ID of the biological experiment (e.g. APEX03, SpaceChile).

date_taken.description: ISO 8601 formatted datetime string indicating when the photograph was taken (e.g. 2026-07-31T16:17:09Z).

camera.description: Camera model, hardware, or device identifier used for capture.

lighting.description: Lighting conditions under which the image was taken (e.g. LED White, FL, Dark, Red grow-light).

scale_bar_mm.description: Physical size of the scale reference in millimeters.

calibration_marker.description: Whether the AstroBotany Spectrum calibration marker is present in the frame.

width_px.description: The width of the image in pixels.

height_px.description: The height of the image in pixels.

notes.description: Free text comments, annotations, or observations.

source_repo.description: URL or owner/repo identifier of the origin repository (e.g. dr-richard-barker/image-analysis-software-and-R-codes).

source_path.description: Subdirectory path of the image folder inside the origin repository (e.g. Londultia).

contributor.description: Name of the scientist, classroom, or citizen scientist who contributed the image data.

license.description: Creative Commons or open-source data license covering the image (e.g. CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0).
